title: Fylgja Infrahub reader document 1
description: What a read of Infrahub is given beside its branch, time and scope, that Infrahub's schema cannot hold: which manufacturer and platform pair is which platform package, the name of the artifact that holds a device's configuration, and whether probes are read (D-082). The Infrahub reader, fylgja-infrahub, reads it with document.py, as YAML or JSON, and its wheel carries this file alone (D-084). It holds no address and no credential: those are FYLGJA_INFRAHUB_ADDRESS and FYLGJA_INFRAHUB_TOKEN (D-042).
$comment: Rule the reader holds across rows: a pair of manufacturer and platform is in one row (reader.platform.duplicate). Pairs are compared exactly, letter case and spacing included. The document refers to no other file.

reader_version.description: The format's version; document.py refuses any other (reader.version.unsupported).

manufacturer.description: The name of the platform's manufacturer in Infrahub (DcimManufacturer); mapping.py matches a device's to it exactly.

platform.description: The name of the device's platform in Infrahub (DcimPlatform); mapping.py matches a device's to it exactly.

package.description: The platform package's id, as its platform package 1 document's id; mapping.py writes it as the blueprint device's platform, which the core's compiler loads.

items.description: One pair of manufacturer and platform and the platform package a device of that pair is; mapping.py refuses a device whose pair is in no row (platform.unmatched).

platforms.description: The pairs the read maps, in any order; mapping.py resolves each scoped device's platform package by them.

artifact.description: The name of the artifact that holds a device's configuration, its definition's artifact_name, the installation's own; artifacts.py reads each scoped device's artifact of that name as the blueprint device's config.

probes.description: Whether the read reads the FylgjaProbe objects; probes.py reads them into the blueprint's probes where true, and an Infrahub without the kind is a fault then alone (probe.kind.absent).
